newsitem.title: LEBANON: Beirut shares mixed on sharply higher turnover. [CORRECTED 13:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Beirut shares mixed on sharply higher turnover. [CORRECTED 13:35 GMT]

text.p: Banks and Solidere shares were mixed on sharply higher turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday.
The BLOM index fell 0.9 percent to 895.20 and the LISPI index fell 0.24 percent to 81.37.
Banque Audi shares rose to $17.25 from Friday's $17 and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce held steady at $12.625.
Turnover in Banque Audi jumped to 26,699 shares from 12,174 on Friday and BLC rose to 7,000 from 2,309.
Solidere A shares fell to $10.25 from $10.375, touching the alltime low which they last hit on January 17. Solidere B shares were unchanged at $10.75.
Some 1,000 Ciments Libanais shares changed hands on the BSE at $1.15625, slightly down from their last trade at $1.1875 on February 27.
Total BSE turnover was 155,222 shares (Corrects from 133,977 shares) for or a value of $1,710,049.25 against 78,904 and $910,270 on Friday.
There was no trade in the three other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Eternit and Uniceramic.
